guard.note: 1.3.3 (not in this pack's 1.1.3: absent in the tested build, sha256_also faunify-1.3.3): cached parent while alive; client: first of Level.getEntities(null, bb.inflate(50), uuid predicate); server: ServerLevel.getEntity(uuid)
getEntities: the entity getter's box search (+ ender dragon parts, + Forge part entities), each tested with the predicate
forEachAccessibleNonEmptySection: sections from box.min - (2, 4, 2) to box.max + (2, 0, 2), accessible ones only: the rule ParentLookup.reached copies
addEntity (client): an entity's section is its block position's; visible entities = the lookup the switch asks

faunify_millipede_parent_uuid_lookup.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Level.getEntities call in MillipedeSegmentEntity.getParentSegment's client branch (string target, @Pseudo): the level's entity lookup by the parent UUID (the segment's synced PARENT_UUID, read again at the call), accepted when its section lies in the range EntitySectionStorage walks for that box (x/z +-2, y -4/+0) and its bounding box intersects the box; else the empty list (what the search finds); the original search runs when the switch is off, the UUID is null or the level is not a client level. Exact variant (documented difference: duplicate client UUIDs). @Invoker on Level.getEntities() (m_142646_). Runtime flag faunifyMillipedeParentUuidLookup. Helper bons.furious.patch.faunify_coo49.ParentLookup.
faunify_millipede_parent_uuid_lookup.license: Faunify (MIT): no code carried; the wrapper answers its own search from the level's lookup

guard.note: canUse: canSteal, then the first player in getEntitiesOfClass(Player, bb.inflate(10)) carrying seeds becomes the target (1.1.3 and 1.3.3)
1.3.3 only (absent in the tested 1.1.3, sha256_also faunify-1.3.3): isEmpty of getEntitiesOfClass(Player, bb.inflate(4))
1.3.3 only: any player of getEntitiesOfClass(Player, bb.inflate(4)) that is neither creative nor spectator
1.3.3 only: the nearest of getEntitiesOfClass(Player, bb.inflate(6)) (first of equal distances)
tick: 1.3.3 asks whether any player of getEntitiesOfClass(Player, bb.inflate(10)) holds the attracting item in a hand; the 1.1.3 tick has no such search (its own fingerprint)
getEntitiesOfClass(class, box) = getEntitiesOfClass(class, box, EntitySelector.NO_SPECTATORS): the filter the player-list answer keeps

faunify_player_proximity_scan_lean.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Level.getEntitiesOfClass(Class, AABB) call of each of the five Faunify player searches (MouseEntity$StealSeedGoal.canUse in 1.1.3 and 1.3.3; BeeflyEntity$BeeflyFlightGoal.canUse, DragonflyEntity$DartingGoal.canUse and findNearestPlayer, SilkMothEntity$SilkMothFlightGoal.canUse and SilkMothEntity.tick in 1.3.3): for Player.class, the level's player list filtered by not-spectator and bounding-box intersection, in join order; any other class runs the search. Fallback trade-off (an exact order-keeping answer would need the shared player layer that was not built), off by default: the documented differences are the player order (first-match and distance-tie choices in multiplayer), Valkyrien Skies' ship-space part of the box, player entities outside the player list and players resized past 4 blocks. The group plugin FaunifyPlugin offers the four 1.3.3-only mixins only when the guard matched faunify-1.3.3. Runtime flag faunifyPlayerProximityScanLean. Helper bons.furious.patch.faunify_coo49.PlayerScan.
faunify_player_proximity_scan_lean.license: Faunify (MIT): no code carried; the wrapper answers its own searches from the level's player list
